mode.title: What do you want to scrape?
mode.description: Pick one job per run. Search / Category / Brand return product listings. Product detail and Seller offers take SKUs or product URLs. Category tree and Filters & facets are research helpers. noon Minutes searches the 15-minute grocery catalogue instead of the main marketplace.
enumTitles: Product detail - full PDP for a SKU
Seller offers - every seller selling a SKU
Category tree - noon's whole category hierarchy
Filters & facets - brands and filters in a category

searchKeywords.title: Search keywords
searchKeywords.description: Used by Search, Filters & facets and noon Minutes. One keyword per line, for example: iphone

categoryPaths.title: Category paths or URLs
categoryPaths.description: Used by Category, Category tree and Filters & facets. Paste a noon category URL or just its path, for example: electronics-and-mobiles/mobiles-and-accessories/mobiles-20905/smartphones

brandCodes.title: Brand codes
brandCodes.description: Used by Brand. The brand's code as it appears in its noon URL, lowercase, for example: apple

productSkus.title: Product SKUs or product URLs
productSkus.description: Used by Product detail and Seller offers. Paste a full noon product URL or just the SKU, for example: N70211544V

targets.title: Targets (generic)
targets.description: Optional. A single list that is routed into whichever field the chosen mode needs, so this actor can be chained from another one without rewiring the input.

country.title: Country
country.description: Which noon storefront to read. This sets the catalogue, the prices and the currency.

language.title: Language
language.description: English or Arabic product titles and descriptions. Prices are identical either way.

maxItems.title: Maximum items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many records in total. Leave empty or 0 for no limit.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages per input
maxPages.description: How deep to paginate each keyword, category or brand. noon stops serving results after page 50 no matter what is set here.

limitPerPage.title: Products per page
limitPerPage.description: How many products to request per page. noon accepts up to 200 and quietly caps anything higher, so 200 means four times fewer requests than the website's own 50.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Ordering for listing modes. Popularity is noon's own default.

sortDir.title: Sort direction
sortDir.description: Ascending or descending. Only applies when Sort by is not Popularity.

priceMin.title: Minimum price
priceMin.description: Optional price floor, in the selected country's currency.

priceMax.title: Maximum price
priceMax.description: Optional price ceiling, in the selected country's currency.

brandFilter.title: Filter by brand
brandFilter.description: Optional. Narrow Search and Category results to one brand, using the brand's lowercase code, for example: apple

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many product pages to fetch at once in Product detail and Seller offers modes.

instantLat.title: noon Minutes: latitude
instantLat.description: Advanced, noon Minutes only. Delivery point latitude as noon encodes it (degrees times 10 million). The default is Downtown Dubai.

instantLng.title: noon Minutes: longitude
instantLng.description: Advanced, noon Minutes only. Delivery point longitude as noon encodes it (degrees times 10 million).

instantEcomZone.title: noon Minutes: zone code
instantEcomZone.description: Advanced, noon Minutes only. Overrides the delivery zone, for example AE_DXB-S14.

instantZoneCode.title: noon Minutes: warehouse code
instantZoneCode.description: Advanced, noon Minutes only. Overrides which dark store's stock is read, for example W00050759A.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Leave this off for search, category, brand, product, seller offers, category tree and filters - they do not need a proxy. Switch on Residential proxy (in the country you want) for noon Minutes, which noon serves only to ordinary consumer connections.

maxRetries.title: Maximum retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a failed request before giving up on it and writing an error row.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for a single response before treating it as failed.

requestDelaySecs.title: Delay between requests (seconds)
requestDelaySecs.description: Optional pause before each request. Leave at 0 unless you are deliberately running slowly.
